text.text: All our documents in one place. Find them by team, type or project, see what is still a draft, and know who owns each.
Short rules that make every document easier to use.
Begin with one sentence that says what the document is for.
Use headings a reader can scan.
Put decisions and dates near the top.
Write names and dates in full.
Say who must do what, by when.

cells.text: A plan others will build or follow
A short ask to a partner or vendor

text.text: Start with the subject, not the type. “Gala budget policy” beats “Policy: gala budget.”
— the owner is still writing. Nobody should rely on it.
— a second person is reading it. Add comments, not edits.
— final. Tick Verified once the owner has confirmed every fact.
— no longer true or needed, kept for the record.
Review every published document once a year, or sooner when the thing it describes changes.
